code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia, leukopenia, neutropenia, lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated D-dimer, ferritin, creatinine, INR, and liver enzymes, with low total protein. These findings suggest acute systemic inflammation, possible infection or sepsis, and multi-organ involvement (renal, hepatic, hematologic). Immediate clinical evaluation is recommended to assess for severe infection, coagulopathy, and organ dysfunction.
